name: Buggane
body:
This tall, feral humanoid has sharp claws and small horns. Bits of twigs and leaves are woven into the matted fur which covers much of its thick hide.

Common Buggane
CR 3

XP 800
NE Large humanoid (giant)
Init +4; Senses low-light vision, tremorsense 5 ft.; Perception +5

AC 17, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+4 Dex, +4 natural, –1 size)
hp 30 (4d8+12)
Fort +7; Ref +5; Will +3

Speed 40 ft., burrow 20 ft.
Melee 2 claws +6 (1d6+4)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks rend (2 claws, 1d6+6)

Str 19, Dex 18, Con 17, Int 6, Wis 10, Cha 7
Base Atk +3; CMB +8; CMD 22
Feats Iron Will, Power Attack
Skills Perception +5, Stealth +6 (+10 in undergrowth); Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth
Languages Giant
SQ camouflaged fur

Environment temperate or cold hills
Organization solitary, pair, gang (3–4), or family (5–16)
Treasure standard

Camouflaged Fur (Ex) Bugganes can create a primitive but effective camouflage by weaving twigs and leaves into their thick fur, granting them a +4 circumstance bonus on Stealth checks when in areas containing undergrowth. This bonus is included in the stat block above.

Mountain Buggane
CR 6

XP 2,400
NE Huge humanoid (giant)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, tremorsense 10 ft.; Perception +7

AC 19, touch 11, flat-footed 16 (+3 Dex, +8 natural, –2 size)
hp 73 (7d8+42)
Fort +11; Ref +5; Will +4

Speed 40 ft., burrow 20 ft.
Melee 2 claws +11 (1d8+7)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks rend (2 claws, 1d8+10)

Str 25, Dex 16, Con 23, Int 6, Wis 10, Cha 7
Base Atk +5; CMB +14; CMD 27
Feats Iron Will, Power Attack, Vital Strike, Weapon Focus (claw)
Skills Perception +7, Stealth +2 (+6 in undergrowth); Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth
Languages Giant
SQ camouflaged fur

Environment temperate or cold mountains
Organization solitary, pair, gang (3–4), or family (5–16)
Treasure standard

Camouflaged Fur (Ex) Bugganes can create a primitive but effective camouflage by weaving twigs and leaves into their thick fur, granting them a +4 circumstance bonus on Stealth checks when in areas containing undergrowth. This bonus is included in the stat block above.

Bugganes are burrowing cousins of common ogres. Compared to other ogres, bugganes are more feral, having fur, claws, and horns. Bugganes don’t use their knobby horns in combat, but frequently rend their opponents with their sharp claws. Bugganes can also use their claws to burrow through soft earth at surprising speeds.

Bugganes are fond of ambush tactics, using camouflage and burrows to hide along roads through hills and mountains, leaping out to strike once unwitting travelers draw near. Once combat is engaged, bugganes forgo additional attempts at stealth and trickery, instead relying upon brute strength. If outmatched, bugganes attempt to flee, making full use of their burrowing capabilities.

A common buggane is 12 feet tall and weighs 500 pounds. A mountain buggane is 20 feet tall and weighs 4,000 pounds. The two species rarely interact, and tend to distrust one another.
